prompt: 三个池子现在感觉都差不多，玩家抽的时候选择感不够强。我想让每个池子更有个性。

assertions.description: Each proposal has all required sections (想法/规则变更/分析)
Rule changes specify actual modifications to pool mechanics
Proposals reference actual pool mechanics accurately
Each proposal explains HOW it creates stronger differentiation and meaningful choice
Proposals describe mechanics in ordinary language
Added complexity is justified as necessary for differentiation
Analysis addresses whether pool differentiation risks reducing fun of the current draw experience
